choice_prompt:2:1660109001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>……让达米安去帮忙真的没关系吗？

choice_prompt:2:1660109001.female: Is it really okay to let Damian join them, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:4:1660109002:0.text: Don't worry, Miss Lyca. <style="stress"><player_name></style> will keep Avalon safe.
say:4:1660109002:0.male: Don't worry, Miss Lyca. <style="stress"><player_name></style> will keep Avalon safe.
say:4:1660109002:0.female: Don't worry, Miss Lyca. <style="stress"><player_name></style> will keep Avalon safe.

say:5:1660109003:0.text: Ah, it's a once-a-year festival. Enjoying ourselves should come first. Indris, don't you agree?
say:5:1660109003:0.source_cn: 眼下还是享受节日的欢乐更要紧。因度厄，你说对吗？

say:8:1660109005:1.text: Well, well, well... Sal'thorin's new leader is quite the cold, humorless sort, isn't he?
say:8:1660109005:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，你们看，萨洛克兰的新领袖真是一个十足的呆子。

say:9:1660109006:1.text: That's exactly what makes him reliable. The Essail are fortunate to have him.
say:9:1660109006:1.source_cn: 但越是这样的人越可靠。对于艾塞勒们来说，这是一件好事。

say:10:1660109007:0.text: Hmm... I'll recommend a trip to Sal'thorin in my next letter to Lorsan. A little time with Indris would do him good.
say:10:1660109007:0.source_cn: 嗯……下次我给洛桑写信时，一定会记得推荐他去萨洛克兰游...

say:11:1660109008:1.text: A new friend? Delightful. I'll make sure he feels right at home.
say:11:1660109008:1.source_cn: 哦，新朋友！好啊，我会好好招待他的。

say:12:1660109009:1.text: Hopefully he's as good-looking as Indris. It'd brighten the spirits of the girls who live without daylight. You know how it is. Underground life gets painfully dull.
say:12:1660109009:1.source_cn: 希望他的容貌也能和因度厄媲美，给那些生活在暗无天日之地...

say:13:1660109010:1.text: Do the Essail really care that much about looks?
say:13:1660109010:1.source_cn: 艾塞勒们……都很喜欢长相漂亮的人？

say:14:1660109011:1.text: Of course, everyone loves a bit of beauty. Elegance is a virtue, after all.
say:14:1660109011:1.source_cn: 当然，爱美之心人皆有之。就像你每次拉弓时总会不自觉地调...

say:15:1660109012:1.text: Take Indris. A report is a lot more pleasant when delivered by someone lovely—somehow the most troublesome matters feel easier to untangle.
say:15:1660109012:1.source_cn: 就像因度厄。像他这样美貌的人来汇报工作，总会让人格外舒...

say:17:1660109014:1.text: Ignore Ravion. He's a bit dramatic about aesthetics.
say:17:1660109014:1.source_cn: 别在意沙利叶的话。他对审美的要求比较极端。

say:18:1660109015:1.text: Anyway, moving on. I've been considering sending a group of guards to train on the surface. Miss Lyca, what would you advise?
say:18:1660109015:1.source_cn: 还是谈些别的吧。我最近想把一批卫队成员送到地表上进行训...

say:19:1660109016:1.text: Oh, come now! During a rare holiday?
say:19:1660109016:1.source_cn: ……好不容易休个假，一定要这样吗？

say:20:1660109017:1.text: Surely we can find more... entertaining ways to spend the day. Cards, perhaps?
say:20:1660109017:1.source_cn: 不如还是来找点别的乐子吧。打打牌怎么样？

choice:2:0:1.text: No worries. I'll handle whatever happens.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 没关系，出了什么事我来解决
choice:2:0:1.male: No worries. I'll handle whatever happens.
choice:2:0:1.female: No worries. I'll handle whatever happens.

choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 有祖娅和呼金在，应该还好吧
